Michael Porter Jr. scored the Nets' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 22 times in 52 starts, or 42% of the games they started. Nic Claxton was next with 15. The Nets made the game's first field goal in 39% of their 82 games and won 56% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
